messages:
mike.sales: Quick transfer for Sigma Co — signed yesterday EOD. Passing context to CSM + Support so we can hit the 30d activation goal. TL;DR: SSO (Okta) + VPC peering planned, data volumetrics are light first 2 months, and renewal is 12/2025 (note: auto-renew clause needs sales confirmation).

priya.csm: Thanks Mike. Can you drop the provisioning creds and contact for their infra lead? Also want to confirm expected launch flow (Pilot -> Prod) and success metrics.

mike.sales: Added infra lead contact: rachel@sigmaco.com. Provisioning creds in 1Password shared with team (item: Sigma-Provision-1705). Pilot scope: 3 routes, 5k tokens/day average. Production expected after pilot if latency < 300ms p95 and no classification drift.

priya.csm: Great. I'll run the activation runbook. Owners: Priya = CSM owner; Noah = Support primary; Evelyn = Eng escalation for VPC/peering.

noah.support: Copy. I'll open a triage ticket and create a troubleshooting playbook for SSO failures. ETA to have initial ticket with checklist: today EOD. Ticket: SUP-7682.

ci-bot: deploy scheduled: sigma-vpc-route-setup on stage at 2024-03-12T16:00Z by evelyn.eng

priya.csm: Priya here with onboarding plan draft (short):
- Day 0: Credentials, Okta test users, invite to workspace and docs
- Week 1: Pilot config, sample prompts + eval set, perf baseline capture
- Week 2-3: Feedback loop with product, quality gates, adjust model/quant settings
- Day 30: Activation review and hand-off to ops

mike.sales: One note on billing: Sigma wants a cap for first 60 days due to compliance — they requested a soft spending limit. Finance flagged we need it in writing. I'll get a signed email today.

evelyn.eng: For the VPC peering, ops asked for the CIDR ranges and a time window for the peering test. Rachel sent CIDR 10.40.0.0/16. Proposed test window: 2024-03-13 10:00-11:00 PT. If that works I'll queue infra change and a canary.

priya.csm: Confirmed. I'll sync with Rachel for the window and coordinate internal on-call. Noah, please make sure SUP-7682 contains runbook steps: okta metadata import, SAML debug checklist, firewall rules, and KV cache warm-up.

noah.support: Will do. Also adding a monitoring hook: create dashboard in Redwood Console for token usage, p50/p95 latency, error-rate per route. I'll attach dashboard link to the ticket once created.

priya.csm: Owners & next steps (short):
- Priya (CSM): coordinate kickoff + invite docs + success metrics + run the Day 0 checklist (owner)
- Noah (Support): SUP-7682 triage ticket + monitoring dashboard (ETA: 1 day)
- Evelyn (Eng): schedule peering change, canary, escalation path (ETA: schedule by EOD)
- Mike (Sales): secure written spending cap approval and share with finance + CSM (ETA: EOD)

mike.sales: I'll ping Rachel now and post here when I have the signed email. @priya.csm please let me know if you need a warm intro with their product owner.

priya.csm: Please cc me on that email. Also capturing a potential renewal risk signal: Sigma mentioned vendor consolidation in 10–11 months, so flagging renewal as 'watch' (score: medium). We'll add quarterly check-ins and a feature usage dashboard to mitigate.

evelyn.eng: One quick technical ask: Sigma wants private model variants later this quarter. We'll need to validate quantization profiles — can we add a spike to roadmap? Priya, want me to open a short RFC?

priya.csm: Yes please open RFC-2047 with scope and estimated effort; mark it non-blocking for Day 0 but required before Prod ramp.

noah.support: All right, creating SUP-7682 now and linking RFC-2047 + 1Password item. Adding follow-up meeting: Kickoff + network window 2024-03-13 10:15 PT (30m).

mike.sales: Signed email from Rachel landed: "confirmed spend cap $1,000/mo for first 60 days" — forwarding to finance and cc'ing @priya.csm.

priya.csm: Got it — thanks. I'll update the account health doc and set renewal watch reminders.

noah.support: Ticket SUP-7682 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-7682 — attachments: onboarding checklist, dashboard stub.

priya.csm: Closing loop — next sync after peering test. If anything blocks, escalate in #eng-oncall and tag @evelyn.eng. :thumbsup:
